title: Retrocede
summary: RETROCE'DE, verb transitive [Latin retro, back, and cedo, to give.] To cede or grant back; as, to retrocede a territory to a former proprietor.

inlines.v: RETROCE'DE, verb transitive [Latin retro, back, and cedo, to give.] To cede or grant back; as, to retrocede a territory to a former proprietor.
